description: This file implements the Android-specific proxy configuration service for Chromium, handling proxy settings retrieval, override, and change notifications via JNI.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::Delegate
classes.description: Manages JNI interactions, proxy configuration updates, and observer notifications for Android proxy settings.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::JNIDelegateImpl
classes.description: JNI delegate implementation for handling proxy setting change callbacks from Java.

methods.name: ConvertStringToPort
methods.description: Converts a string to a port number, validating the result.

methods.name: ConstructProxyServer
methods.description: Constructs a ProxyServer object from scheme, host, and port strings.

methods.name: LookupProxy
methods.description: Looks up proxy settings based on a prefix and scheme.

methods.name: AddBypassRules
methods.description: Adds bypass rules based on non-proxy host patterns.

methods.name: GetProxyRules
methods.description: Retrieves proxy rules from system properties.

methods.name: GetJavaProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a system property via Java.

methods.name: CreateStaticProxyConfig
methods.description: Creates a static proxy configuration from host, port, PAC URL, and exclusions.

methods.name: ParseOverrideRules
methods.description: Parses override proxy rules into ProxyRules structure.

methods.name: CreateOverrideProxyConfig
methods.description: Creates an override proxy configuration from rules and bypass list.
